remarks: Newly renovated in-town charmer in sought-after New Canaan, CT. Thoughtfully updated to blend vintage character with modern amenities, this home offers timeless appeal with today's comforts. Ideally located just steps to the train, supermarkets, restaurants, and all the conveniences of town, the setting is truly exceptional. Enjoy access through the back and side yard, providing a few-step entry option for added ease. Located within New Canaan's award-winning school district, this is a rare rental opportunity offering location, charm, and convenience - all in one.
